Reduction over padded windows

Source: R/lax_windowed.R
lax_reduce_window.Rd

Port of jax.lax.reduce_window (XLA ReduceWindowWithGeneralPadding). With lax_add, lax_max or lax_min and their identity as initial value the specialized reductions reduce_window_sum, reduce_window_max and reduce_window_min are used.

Usage

lax_reduce_window(
  operand,
  init_value,
  computation,
  window_dimensions,
  window_strides = NULL,
  padding = "VALID",
  base_dilation = NULL,
  window_dilation = NULL
)

Arguments

operand

Array or pytree (list) of arrays.

init_value

Scalar or pytree of scalars with the structure of operand.

computation

Function of two arguments with the structure of operand.

window_dimensions

Integer vector of window sizes.

window_strides

Optional integer vector of strides (default 1).

padding

"VALID" (default), "SAME", "SAME_LOWER" or a list of c(low, high) pairs.

base_dilation, window_dilation

Optional integer vectors of dilations.

Value

An array or a pytree of arrays with the structure of operand.
